eval_model_on_dataset: evaluate a motion prediction model on a dataset and return average loss
generate_motion_sequences: generate output motion sequences from input sequences using a trained model
run_inference_no_teacher_forcing: run model inference with teacher forcing ratio set to zero for generation
review_eval_function: review the eval function that computes average loss over a dataset using a criterion
summarize_generate_function: summarize the generate function that produces motion sequences via a forward pass
